verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions calendar invites, interview kits, scorecards attached to interviews, or feedback-submission reminders. The only related material is an API endpoint for creating a candidate rating and MCP tools to rate or review candidates. These are adjacent rating features, not automated interviewer preparation, so they earn no credit for this applicable ATS axis.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
